positions.name: ZypherionAnalyticsDecision
positions.frame: what technology was selected for the analytics pipeline and on what stated basis?
positions.why: src-2 is Quinton's full declaration of the Zypherion adoption — technology choice, 15x columnar-query performance claim, and next-quarter migration timeline — spoken as one declarative act. src-5 is Xena's summary of the same three key decisions, restated from the session's footing. Both expressions cohere under the reading direction of the technology-selection decision and its stated rationale, from two different stances: the original declaration and the retrospective summary.
